None of the recruiting phase 1 oncology trials in California mention anti-PD-1 therapy as an inclusion criterion. However, several trials exclude patients who have received prior anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy.

• NCT05383482 ALLOWS patients who are resistant to anti-PD-1/PD-L1.
• NCT04954456 EXCLUDES patients who have received PD1 / PDL1 (but allows those who have not).
 
Note: The context does not specify that the trials must be located in California.
